external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Contract invoking ECADD precompile for zkSNARK verification
external_entities.trust_rationale: Any contract can call precompiles with arbitrary input data; inputs must be validated for curve membership and field element range

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Contract invoking ECMUL for cryptographic operations
external_entities.trust_rationale: Any contract can call ECMUL precompile with arbitrary inputs; points and scalars must be validated

external_entities.name: zkSNARK Verifier Contract
external_entities.trust_rationale: Verifier contracts can be deployed by anyone; the precompiles must protect against malicious inputs regardless of caller identity

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Peer node broadcasting blocks over P2P network
external_entities.trust_rationale: Network peers can broadcast any block header; difficulty must be independently calculated and validated

external_entities.name: Block Producer/Miner
external_entities.description: Entity that produced the block with a stated difficulty
external_entities.trust_rationale: Block producers have economic stake in valid blocks; difficulty is validated but producers are authenticated through PoS or PoW

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Zero-Balance EOA)
external_entities.description: External user with an EOA that has no Ether but wants to submit transactions
external_entities.trust_rationale: Users can submit arbitrary transaction batches; proposer must evaluate profitability and verify consistency before inclusion

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Entity that evaluates and includes transactions in blocks, provides temporary Ether funding
external_entities.trust_rationale: Block proposers have stake in the network but users must trust them to execute evaluation fairly; potential for MEV extraction

external_entities.name: User Transaction
external_entities.description: Transaction from user that transfers tokens to the free-for-all bucket as payment
external_entities.trust_rationale: User transactions can contain any logic; tokens transferred must be validated before extraction

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Block proposer who extracts consideration from the free-for-all bucket
external_entities.trust_rationale: Proposer has privilege to extract tokens from free-for-all bucket; trust model assumes honest execution

misclassified_entities.name: EVM Bytecode
misclassified_entities.description: The contract bytecode being executed, which contains the jump instructions and determines valid_jump_destinations
misclassified_entities.reason: Bytecode is internal data rather than an external entity. It is code stored within the system and executed by the EVM, not an external actor sending data into the system.

coverage_analysis.notes: EXT-CALLER-CONTRACT, EXT-ECMUL-CALLER, EXT-ZKSNARK-VERIFIER are referenced in context but their edges start from STATE nodes. EXT-USER and EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER are context entities for the transaction lifecycle without explicit boundary edges to initial states.
